name: Port chaos-ui: the native library, its binding, nodes, styles, layout and drawing

comments.text: Done in part 1 (D-046): engine/native builds liblantern-native (Nyx's C API, Chaos, Cosmos and the bridge, moved to Chaos's current Equinox names); src/chaosui ports node, style, layout, draw and ChaosUi; tests/chaosui ports all 7 chaos_ui.rs tests, passing on the native and C backends.
